UPSSSC Stenographer 13/2024 Documents Upload 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Documents Upload Notice for the Stenographer Post. This recruitment was released for 1224 posts. The applications for UPSSSC Stenographer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from December 26, 2024, to January 25, 2025. The Skill Test examination was conducted on 01 September 2026. Candidates can download their UPSSSC Stenographer Documents Upload 2026 from the link provided below.

  • Skill Test Exam Date : 01 September 2026

  • Documents Upload : 29 October 2026 to 12 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
